results.title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
results.overview: Sanju moves from Nagpur to Mumbai for work and stays with his late mother's friend Viswanath. He falls for Viswanath's daughter Anu, but her marriage is arranged with another man, leaving Viswanath caught between friendship and fatherhood.

results.title: Elsewhere
results.overview: A queer married couple in NYC faces the aftermath of a devastating loss.

results.title: Paris Cafe
results.overview: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

results.title: Attack of the Kraken
results.overview: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.

results.title: Face to Face: Don Bachardy
results.overview: A revealing documentary that explores the vibrant life, work, and flamboyant personality of portrait artist Don Bachardy, focusing on his lifelong romantic partnership with novelist Christopher Isherwood. From their Santa Monica home, Bachardy spills vivid details on his sitters: how he got to touch Ginger Rogers' face, how Henry Fonda—who famously hated queers—eventually came around to pose for him, and how Governor Jerry Brown actually sat for his portrait 40 years ago, unlike Ronnie and Arnold. Bachardy's unique philosophy allows him to enter his sitters' lives, discern their personalities, and see straight into their souls. Yet, the emotional core and pinnacle of the documentary is his profound bond with Isherwood. During Isherwood's final six months, as he lay bedridden and dying right in front of him, Bachardy produced 448 black-paint portraits. Explaining that his paintbrush was in mourning, Bachardy offers a breathtaking, devastatingly pure expression of love and loss.

results.title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2
results.overview: A mismatched pair, with a storyline involving a wrestler and a vibrant girl, combining romance, comedy, and drama.

results.title: Summer's Last Resort
results.overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

results.title: Morten
results.overview: A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.

results.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 Eric Lu in Stockholm
results.original_title: Beethoven: Concerto per pianoforte n. 3 Eric Lu a Stoccolma
results.overview: American pianist Eric Lu is one of the rising stars of his generation. As part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe, Lu plays for the first time with the Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by its principal conductor Ryan Bancroft. On the programme: Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3.

results.title: Different Girls
results.overview: After discovering her boyfriend's infidelity with sex workers, Sabina, a trans woman, is drawn into a painful grieving process and a deep crisis of inferiority. When the opportunity arises to experience that same betrayal from the other side, she must decide whether to give in to the impulse of validation or seek her own revenge.

results.title: Framing Her
results.overview: A young filmmaker travels across Asia to document independent women directors, but their stories bring her own past to the surface.

results.title: Ilona
results.overview: The trial of Ilona Tóth and her co-defendants, a case of post-’56 reprisals, received widespread publicity and remains a subject of controversy to this day. According to the charges, the young medical student abused her professional position to execute an innocent man with particular cruelty. Despite the confessions, the absurdity of the trial’s details and the numerous contradictions suggest that the young people sentenced to death were victims of a show trial. In this true-crime film, using modern investigative methods, we explore the methods of reprisal, the cruelty of show trials, and why those in power needed this show trial, as well as how they sought to discredit the revolution in the eyes of international public opinion through it.

results.title: Blood Moon Rite 8
results.overview: In an abandoned amusement park, a shoestring budget horror film is rolling. The crew features a "washed‐up yet unwavering" director, a leading couple whose onscreen romance has bled into real life, and a hot‐tempered makeup artist. The true nightmare begins when the director performs a "Blood Moon Ritual" meant to force genuine terror from his actors, no acting, only real fear and real tears.

results.title: Ice-Pocalypse
results.overview: A new moon caught in Earth's gravitational pull results in an Ice Age. Scientists and the military must destroy the second moon before it's too late.

results.title: Капитан Невельской и земли Чёрного дракона
results.original_title: Капитан Невельской и земли Чёрного дракона
results.overview: Captain Gennadiy Nevelskoy, an excellent student at the Naval Academy, is forced by his talent to teach naval science to the Tsarevich instead of conquering distant seas, watching as other people's dreams replace his own. Fourteen-year-old Nadezhda, a young student at the Institute for Noble Maidens, has never found her place in the capital. Deep down, she knows her true home is lost somewhere in the lands of the Far East, and she must return there. Upon meeting each other, Gennadiy and Nadezhda embark on a great and dangerous adventure-a search for themselves and their place in the world.

results.title: Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos
results.overview: Chronically unsuccessful MI7 operative Happy Patel is finally assigned a mission in Goa, where he uncovers his Indian roots and must rescue a high-profile scientist from crime lord Mama. Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

results.title: Mama's Little Murderer
results.overview: A devoted single mother, Constance, struggles to balance her newfound love with Leo and the obsessive, destructive behavior of her son, Anthony, who will go to extreme lengths to keep her to himself.

results.title: Mysterioso
results.overview: Musically exploring some of the mysteries of the world.
